meta.units: cm, heart frame (origin MV centre, Z = LV long axis base→apex, X = toward the RV/septum, Y = inferior-posterior)
notes: Baked from the phantom's scene() at end-diastole (tissue) and at the valve phases; companion of heart-mesh.json (outer surface, coronaries).
tissue: one closed surface; clip it with a plane and cap the cut by sampling the phantom (or the label colours) to show internal anatomy.
valves: flip-book keyframes on the ECG clock (phases = fraction of RR, 0 = R wave). Chordae are part of the MV frames.
landmarks: placed from the phantom; conduction paths are teaching layouts (verify with an expert).

heart._note: Right-handed. All cardiac landmarks/shapes below are in this frame. Engine transform: p_patient = origin + x_h*X + y_h*Y + z_h*Z.

axes.X: from LV toward RV / septum (≈ anterior-right): the 'S' axis
axes.Y: inferior-posterior (diaphragmatic side, coronary sinus side). -Y = anterior-superior (LVOT/aorta side)

heart.teachingNote: A4C plane ≈ X–Z plane (Y≈0). Tilting the beam toward -Y opens the LVOT (A5C); toward +Y shows the coronary sinus (pitfall).

frames._matrixNote: column-major 4×4 (three.js Matrix4.fromArray): p_body = heartToBody · p_heart (cm); p_H3 = heartToH3 · p_heart (heart-3d-model units, 1 unit ≈ 7.08 cm)

sa_node.note: Sinoatrial node site: SVC–RA junction at the top of the crista terminalis, subepicardial.

av_node.note: Compact AV node: apex of Koch's triangle, just in front of the central fibrous body.

central_fibrous_body.note: Right fibrous trigone, pierced by the His bundle.

membranous_septum.note: Under the RCC–NCC commissure; His runs along its lower edge.

his_bundle.note: AV node → through the CFB → along the lower edge of the membranous septum → crest of the muscular septum.

his_bifurcation.note: Crest of the muscular septum, LV side, below the membranous septum.

lbb_anterior_fascicle.note: Left anterior fascicle → base of the anterolateral papillary muscle.

lbb_posterior_fascicle.note: Left posterior fascicle → base of the posteromedial papillary muscle.

lbb_septal_fascicle.note: Septal fibres down the LV septal surface toward the apex.

rbb.note: Right bundle branch down the RV septal surface to the septal end of the moderator band.

moderator_band.note: Carries the RBB to the anterior papillary muscle of the RV.

internodal_anterior.note: Anterior internodal route (gives off Bachmann's bundle).

internodal_middle.note: Middle (Wenckebach) route, behind the SVC, along the fossa limbus.

internodal_posterior.note: Posterior (Thorel) route along the crista terminalis and the Eustachian ridge.

bachmann_bundle.note: Interatrial band: anterior RA → LA roof → LAA base.

koch_triangle.note: Bounded by the CS ostium, the tendon of Todaro and the TV septal hinge; the compact AV node lies at its apex.

cti.note: Cavotricuspid isthmus: the slow zone of typical flutter, ablation line.
